belagavi_city_pilot.name: Belagavi City Pilot
belagavi_city_pilot.coordinate_source: Belagavi Cantonment Board official city map page
belagavi_city_pilot.coordinate_semantics: Representative city reference point; not a groundwater station coordinate or a verified weather-grid cell centre.
limitations: City reference coordinate is a single-point pilot and does not represent the whole Belagavi district.
ERA5 is a reanalysis grid estimate, not an on-site weather-station observation.
The candidate radius is for station discovery only; it is not a scientifically validated join radius.
Groundwater station coordinates, timestamps, measurement datum and local relevance require review before any join.
